narration: Those words were simply likely there. They are not a measurement of anything real.
caption: वे शब्द वहाँ सिर्फ़ मुमकिन थे। वे किसी सच की नाप नहीं हैं।
image_brief: A thermometer with no scale markings mounted on a plain wall, the liquid column clearly risen but unreadable, a shadow falling across the tube, side light.

narration: And AI is not one single thing. Image tools predict pixels, not text tokens.
caption: और एआई एक चीज़ नहीं है। इमेज वाले औज़ार पिक्सल का अंदाज़ा लगाते हैं।
image_brief: A printed photograph enlarged until individual square pixels are visible, taped to a wall beside an unrelated sheet of plain text, flat gallery light.

narration: Spam filters and recommenders work differently again. This chain describes language models only. Nothing else.
caption: स्पैम फ़िल्टर और सुझाव देने वाले अलग ढंग से चलते हैं। यह बात भाषा मॉडल की है।
image_brief: Three separate labelled machines on a workshop shelf, each a different shape and size, no wires running between any of them, dusty concrete wall, low light.

narration: Return to the opening line. One guess, repeated, with no plan sitting behind it.
caption: शुरुआती बात पर लौटिए: एक अंदाज़ा, बार-बार, बिना किसी योजना के।
image_brief: The first printed sheet from earlier, its word-shaped blank now filled in pencil, the sheet lying on top of a thick finished stack of pages, warm lamplight.

narration: That sounded like nothing but a weakness. Half of it is actually your leverage.
caption: यह कमज़ोरी जैसा लगा था। आधा हिस्सा असल में आपकी ताक़त है।
image_brief: A bent iron bar used as a lever under the edge of a heavy stone slab, a small wooden block serving as the fulcrum, gravel underfoot, hard afternoon light.

narration: You cannot change what the model absorbed during training. That part is completely fixed.
caption: प्रशिक्षण में जो सीखा गया, उसे आप बदल नहीं सकते। वह तय है।
image_brief: A cast concrete block set into a floor with a maker's mark pressed into it while wet, the surface now fully cured and hard, cool overcast light.

narration: But every word you supply reshapes the shortlist, at every single step. Every one.
caption: लेकिन आपके दिए हर शब्द से हर चरण की सूची बदल जाती है।
image_brief: A set of railway points beside a track, the switch blade thrown to one side, two rails diverging into the distance, gravel ballast, low sun along the rails.

narration: Vague prompt, wide shortlist, invented specifics. Precise prompt, narrow shortlist, far less invention. Same model.
caption: अधूरा सवाल: चौड़ी सूची और गढ़ंत। साफ़ सवाल: छोटी सूची, कम गढ़ंत।
image_brief: Two paper funnels standing side by side on a bench, one with a wide mouth and one narrow, a scatter of loose beads around the wide one only, even bench light.

narration: Paste the real document in. Then the constrained slots no longer need inventing at all.
caption: असली दस्तावेज़ साथ दीजिए। तब तय जगहों को कुछ गढ़ना नहीं पड़ता।
image_brief: A printed source document laid directly beneath a half-finished summary sheet on a desk, matching figures visible on both pages, clean daylight from the left.

narration: And the confidence you hear finally has a source. It is sentence fit, nothing else.
caption: जो भरोसा सुनाई देता है उसका स्रोत साफ़ है: वाक्य का बैठ जाना।
image_brief: A wooden joint fitted perfectly together on a workbench, no gap along the seam, a capped glue bottle beside it, sawdust swept into a small pile, warm light.

narration: It is the sound of words that follow each other well. Nothing deeper than that.
caption: यह उन शब्दों की आवाज़ है जो एक-दूसरे के बाद ठीक बैठते हैं।
image_brief: A tuning fork resting on a polished stone slab beside a closed unlabelled instrument case, the fork completely still, soft reflected light across the stone.

narration: So trust the shape of an answer more than its specifics. That ordering matters.
caption: जवाब के ढाँचे पर ज़्यादा भरोसा कीजिए, ब्यौरों पर कम। क्रम यही है।
image_brief: A pencil outline of a building on tracing paper laid over a detailed plan, the outline crisp while the fine dimensions beneath show through softened, soft light.

narration: Structure comes from patterns seen everywhere. A specific number comes from one open slot.
caption: ढाँचा हर जगह दिखे नमूनों से आता है। कोई एक आंकड़ा एक खुली जगह से।
image_brief: A woven basket standing upright on a table with one broken reed sticking out of an otherwise tight weave, the flaw clearly local, warm directional light.

narration: One action, right now. Open the last AI answer you actually relied on for something.
caption: एक काम अभी: वह पिछला एआई जवाब खोलिए जिस पर आपने भरोसा किया था।
image_brief: A phone propped against a mug on a table showing a long scrolled block of grey text, a paper notepad open beside it with one ruled line marked, morning light.

narration: Find every number and name inside it. Check only those. Sixty seconds, well spent.
caption: उसमें हर आंकड़ा और नाम ढूँढिए। सिर्फ़ उन्हें जाँचिए। साठ सेकंड।
image_brief: A printed page with three items circled in pencil, two numbers and one proper name, the rest of the page untouched, a small clock face at the edge, clear light.
